lane:
بشنين

بَشْنِينٌ , with fet-h, and then sukoon, and then kesr, _I. q._ نيلوفر [i. e. نِيلُوفَرٌ and نَيْلُوفَرٌ or نَيْلَوْفَرٌ, the _nymphæa lotus,_ or _white lotus:_ and the _nymphæa cærulea,_ or _blue lotus:_ see art. نيلوفر]: a word of the dial. of Egypt. (TA.)
